segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The prophet Joel looked down the long corridor of time and described a day the LORD promised — not for a few insiders, but for all.

segments.speaker: god
segments.text: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:

segments.speaker: god
segments.text: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Not stopped by age or status — every kind of person, filled with the same Spirit.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Decades later, on the day of Pentecost, the apostle Peter stood and said this promise had arrived. The Spirit fell, and ordinary people told of the mighty works of God.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The promise was never meant to be locked in one building or one office. It was poured out — freely, widely, for whoever calls on the name of the LORD.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The promise was all flesh. That includes you. The Spirit is offered — receive Him.
